class.name: DefaultItemAnimator
class.brief_description: Standard fade / slide animations for add, remove, move and change.
class.description: DefaultItemAnimator is the built-in item animator and the RecyclerView default. It fades added items in, fades removed items out (recycling them when finished), and slides moved items from their pre-layout position to the current target (so they follow scrolling). The animation durations are fixed (move 0.3s, add/remove 0.25s, change 0.2s) and cannot be configured from GDScript. To customize timing or effects, subclass [b]ItemAnimator[/b] instead.
